'''LEP-86C8''' was an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] that served [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a high voice and spoke in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Bunnydroid02.png|thumb|left|180px|LEP-86C8 hiding in the greenhouse.]]

LEP-86C8 worked for [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] during the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] incident. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was charged with returning a [[Viral bomb/Legends|virus bomb]] to the bomb storage area. On its way there it witnessed a battle between [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Fearing the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] would destroy the bomb, the droid took another route. Soon it reached the greenhouse where [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] found it. When the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] asked for the bomb, the droid suddenly jumped out at her and fled. Luckily, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] managed to take the bomb away, but unfortunately the droid managed to keep the virus. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] realized their mistake, they initiated a search for the missing droid. The assistant droid saw this as his one chance to release the virus. Eventually, the droid made it to the bomb area, but was intercepted by clones. However, the clones were unable to stop the droid, causing it to detonate the bomb and spread the Blue Shadow Virus. The resulting explosion destroyed LEP-86C8.
